sections.title: ZX Bank: ATMs at Famous Restaurants (India's Major Cities)

location.heading: ZX Bank: ATMs at Famous Restaurants (India's Major Cities)

blocks.text: Below is a list of ZX Bank ATMs conveniently located at or near popular, high-traffic restaurants in each major city. This list is ideal for travelers, foodies, and city-dwellers who love to dine out and need quick banking and cash withdrawal access. Each location includes the restaurant name and full address. (Note: Addresses are examples for demonstration.)
